verdict.rationale: Publishing independent security audits is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions third-party audits, penetration tests, or assessments of the apps or the sync protocol. Open-source licensing, local vault health reports and community comments on supply-chain incidents are not published independent audits, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
